label: Controlled dependence of a favouring profile on a feature across variation scenarios
definition: DependsUnder g ctrl φ s x y: at s the feature g ranks x over y and the profile φ (the source's favouring in each variation scenario) favours x over y, and some scenario t with ctrl t = ctrl s has neither g nor φ ranking x over y. Tracks φ f: φ coincides with the feature f in every scenario. Fixed φ: φ is the same in every scenario. AlignedAt φ f s: they coincide at s. A profile favouring what g does not rank higher at s (perverse or biased) does not depend on g there.
note: Stipulative, an interventionist-style test of whether a feature makes a difference to a source's favouring while another feature is held fixed. Scenarios are formal variation points; when the varied feature is a goodness fact that is necessary, the variation is counterpossible, and GoodDependenceLaws law 4 states what follows without it. It does not say that difference-making is the only kind of explanatory relevance. See docs/notes/optimal-creation-choice.md §§65–69.
